title: OCSF 3002 — Authentication
description: OCSF Authentication class (category_uid=3 Identity & Access Management). Inherits class semantics from OCSF v1.3.

status_code.description: The source's failure code as lowercase hexadecimal text with the 0x prefix (Windows Status). Present on failures (SPEC-020).

status_detail.description: The source's detailed failure code, same form (Windows SubStatus). Present on failures (SPEC-020).

auth_protocol.description: The authentication package as the source writes it (e.g. 'Negotiate', 'NTLM', 'Kerberos'); '-' when it has none.

cg_elevated_token.description: CGES extension (ADR-0006, ADR-0019 §4): whether the logon's token is elevated (Windows ElevatedToken). Present on successful logons whose source carries it; OCSF 1.3 maps no field to it.
